# Gargoyle (`monsters:gargoyle`)
*Medium elemental, chaotic evil* | **CR** 2 (XP 450; PB +2)
**AC** 15 | **HP** 67 (9d8 + 27) | **Speed** 30 ft., fly 60 ft.
**STR** 15 (+2) | **DEX** 11 (+0) | **CON** 16 (+3) | **INT** 6 (-2) | **WIS** 11 (+0) | **CHA** 7 (-2)
**Skills:** [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +4
**Damage Immunities:** poison
**Condition Immunities:** [Exhaustion](../conditions/exhaustion.md), [Petrified](../conditions/petrified.md), [Poisoned](../conditions/poisoned.md)
**Senses:** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10
**Languages:** Primordial (Terran)

## Traits
- **Flyby.** The gargoyle doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The gargoyle makes two Claw attacks.
- **Claw.** Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
